versions.changelog:
Initial release of the Work Productivity Pollyreach Gives Workflow Helper skill.

- Provides validated, high-demand support for creating, fixing, and improving PollyReach-style workflows for AI agents and maintainers.
- Delivers practical outputs such as work plans, templates, scripts, checklists, or decision aids aligned with user constraints and available inputs.
- Emphasizes local hardware–friendly solutions over cloud-only approaches.
- Includes built-in validation and verification steps so users can confidently apply results.
- Supports requests using relevant trigger keywords and phrases related to work productivity and workflow improvement.
